units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:16">Targ. Gen. II, 16</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:36">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>כד אתון יֵיכלון</he> when they came and were about eating; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:36">ib.</cite> (more corr.) <he>אתון מיכל</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: with קרצי prop. to eat (the bread of) destruction, eat the informer’s bread, hence to inform against.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 15:3">Targ. Ps. XV, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:2">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>איכול בהו קו׳</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:3">Lam. R. to IV, 2</cite> <he>איכול קרצהון</he> I will inform against them.

senses.gloss: to give to eat, to support. Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ bot. אוכלה ליה he gave it to him to eat.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:14">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, end (read:) <he>אוכלית אשקית לוי</he> hast thou given (thy guest) to eat? to drink? do escort him, i.e. perform thy duties fully. Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ <he>הוה מייכל לאבוי וכ׳</he> fed his father on &c.; a. fr.

Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 23; a. fr. Tanḥ. Emor, 6 ומה דהבא מִתְאֲכִיל וכ׳; Lev. R. s. 27 ומה זה וכ׳ what is this? do they eat gold &c.? Kidd. 59ᵃ קא מתאכלי were eaten up (spent). [אכלי Af. of כלי to cry, v. כלי.]
